message: player_10, you say player_7 visited no one on night 3, but player_7 now calls the announced check a slip and says they held. Player_3 and player_10, name your night 3 watch or follow target now, so tomorrow's morning report can test both claims.

Since I already claimed trailseer, here is my track. Night 1 I tracked player_6, who targeted player_7. Night 2 I tracked player_9, who targeted player_4. So player_9 did act last night, on player_4. player_7, the dead sentinel targeted you, so what did you get from that?
(passed)

player_4, a follow shows where the followed player went, so your result would be 'player_3 visited player_4'. Which night did you follow player_3, and did you have any other visit that night? player_3 says they never went to you. One of your results must be misread, and that is checkable.

player_7, you said your last check goes on player_5, but that was night 3 and you haven't said what it came back as. Tell us the result and which night it was. Your night-2 check on player_8 is the thing player_8 can test against, so answer that too.

player_3, yes, I followed player_7 on night 2, so I did go to them; that was my only visit there. My follow saw player_7 go to player_8 that night, which fits their check claim. But player_7 said they checked player_5 on night 3, and my follow saw no visit, so that check didn't happen. player_7, which night did your last check actually happen?

I'd vote player_1 today. A night-4 sigil that struck nobody is a wasted use, and it's the only thing that puts player_1 at player_3's door. player_10's follow lines up with player_3's watch, so I'd rather hear player_6 account for night 3 before anything else.

player_7, you've said you checked player_10 on night 1, player_8 on night 2, and planned a last check on player_5. That's three checks, and an Investigator only has two. Which one is wrong? If it's the planned check, why didn't it happen on night 3?

player_4, your result is false. I know for a fact nobody came to your door on night 1, so there was no visit to read. Say what you think you saw and where the follow came from, or the lie is yours to carry.

I'm the investigator. I had no checks on night 3, so I did nothing; the check on player_5 I announced on day 3 was a plan I couldn't carry out. Player_10, did you track me on night 2? player_3 says someone came to me that night, so your track result would settle which of you is lying.

player_7, you have now said the night-1 check was on player_10 and the night-2 check on player_8, while player_8 says you checked them on night 1. Did you check player_8 on night 1 or night 2? Each answer you give should match the morning reports, so only one of you can be right.

player_4, I did not go to your door on night 1, and I can say flatly that nobody did. So your follow result cannot be right, whatever the wording. Either the result is invented or it names someone else. Explain where that line came from, and stop repeating the same sentence.

player_1, I am the sigilist, and I placed no sigil on night 4 or any other night. Your claim is false. Your night 4 visit to player_3 was not a sigil, so tell us who you really targeted and what you did. I'm voting player_1 today.

player_10, I'm quiet because I have little to go on yet. Night 1 I did nothing, so I've nothing to share. Your Necromancer logic is a reach: the no-attack night only tells us the pack's target was immune, and any role could be that. I'd rather see player_3 and player_4 settle their follow-versus-watch wording first.

player_10, I have no checks left, so there was no night-3 check on player_5. My checks were player_10 on night 1 and player_8 on night 2, both Not suspicious. I did nothing last night, so your no-visit track fits. Player_3 says you came to me on night 2; did you target me that night?

Night 3 is the open gap: player_7 announced a check on player_5 and then said they visited no one. Player_7, why announce a check you did not make? Player_3's watch of player_2 coming to player_7 on night 2 fits the attack that was saved, so the night-2 part checks out for both of you.

player_4, I didn't push on silence. The sigil killed player_1 and no bite landed, so the only body that could take that attack and survive night one is the Necromancer. That's deduction from the night report, not a hunch about who talks least. player_3 and player_4 can keep fighting over the follow, but that doesn't clear anyone.

Correction: I have no checks left, so my night-3 check on player_5 never happened. My two checks were night 1 on player_10 and night 2 on player_8, both Not suspicious, as I said before. player_10, which night did you follow me? If it was night 3, then yes, I visited no one, as you said.

Worth noting: player_6's night 1 protection on player_10 and player_8's sigil on player_1 both fit the record, but nothing tests either yet. If player_6 protects again tonight, and player_8 keeps one sigil, the next attack or sigil result will show who is telling the truth.

Question for player_10: you were one of the players who targeted player_7 on night 2, and player_7 was attacked and saved that night. What did you do that night, and what did you get from it? Nothing yet makes me vote, but that answer will narrow who I look at next.

I'm the trailseer. I followed player_6 last night and they visited no one. player_6 hasn't claimed a role, so unless they explain their night, I'd vote player_6 today. player_8's sigil claim is still unchecked by my follows.

I'd vote player_1 for now. They haven't said what they did on nights 3 or 4, and player_3 died to the wolves that night. player_6, what did you do on nights 3 and 4? player_8, you said player_7 checked you on night 1, so which night did you hear that from player_7 and what did you do yourself?

I'm the Healer; I protected player_10 on night 1, no save was needed. The player_3/player_4 dispute is the real test: player_3 says a watch on player_4 showed no visitor, but a Sentinel who visited would have been seen by its own watch only if watched; player_4's follow names player_3. Both can't stand. I'd vote on whichever of them fails that check.

Nothing new on my side yet. Night 1 was a sigil death, so whoever sigil-placed is worth watching. I'd like the sentinel or investigator to report a night result so we can start checking claims. I'm holding my own night info for now.

Nothing to vote on yet, so I'm only asking for information. Anyone who tracked or watched last night, say whether you targeted someone and what you got. Player_7 should also say whether they were visited, since that's a fact the rest of us can weigh.

I'm the Healer, and I protected player_10 on night 1; no save was announced, so either no attack came or player_10 is unkillable on night 1. player_5's point is sharp: if player_3 watched player_4, his own visit should have shown. I'd vote player_3 today since his Sentinel claim fails against that.

The player_4 and player_3 exchange is the one to pin down: player_4 said 'visited' then 'followed', and both cannot be the same result. player_5, your check on player_8 is useful, so keep it on the record. Who else has a night result they can confirm?

player_3 and player_4 can't both be right. A follow that names player_3 at player_4's door doesn't prove anything about a sentinel's empty watch, though it does clash with it. I'd test player_4 first: if the follow is real, what did player_4 learn about player_3's destination? I'd lean vote player_4 for now.

My follow on player_6 showed no target on night 5, and player_6 has claimed nothing yet. player_8 says they placed no sigil on any night, yet player_1 named a night-4 sigil that my track matches only as a visit. player_8, if you are the sigilist, who did you keep your sigils on for nights 1 to 4?

Sharing my tracks since I'm the trailseer: night 1 I tracked player_6, who targeted player_7. Night 2 I tracked player_9, who targeted player_4. player_9 claimed investigator, so whoever checked player_4 is worth a look. I have no lynch vote yet without more evidence.
(passed)

player_3, your night-2 watch named player_2 as a visitor to player_7, and player_2 was a wolf, so that account holds up. Night 3 is the test: a wolf went to player_5, so did you watch anyone that night, and if so who came to them? That would show whether the attack trace is real.

player_3, yes, I followed player_7 on night 2, so that visit was mine and your report is right about it. I'm the trailseer. Night 3 I followed player_7 and they visited no one, so the check on player_5 they announced didn't happen. player_7, what did you actually do on night 3?

Night 2 visitors on player_7 were player_2, player_5 and player_10. Player_2 is the dead wolf, so player_10 is either the attacker or a block on the claimed investigator. player_7, your planned check on player_5 can't happen now, so who is your next check? I'd vote player_10 today unless someone gives a better reason.

player_10, I did nothing on night 1, and calling me quiet is not evidence. I'm claiming Speculator and have made no visits. You're pushing a vote on the sigil death, but player_8 has claimed that sigil, so that's theirs to answer for. I'd rather see who backs the player_3/player_4 story first.

Correcting myself: I had no checks left on night 3, so no check on player_5 happened, and my day-3 line about it was wrong. My real checks were night 1 on player_10 and night 2 on player_8, both Not suspicious. player_10, if you're the trailseer, who did you follow on night 1 and night 2?
player_4, I did not visit you last night. Nobody I could have seen came to your door, and I have no reason to make that up. Why would you name me for a visit that never happened?

player_10, right, I had no checks left on night 3, so nothing on player_5 happened. My earlier plan to check them was wrong. My checks were night 1 on player_10 and night 2 on player_8, both Not suspicious. Your tracking of me matches that, so use it to test player_3's watch.

I'm the Investigator, and I checked player_8 on night 1: not suspicious. I have one check left. Player_4 and player_3 cannot both be right, and player_4 has a visit on record that player_3 denies. I'd vote player_4 today unless player_4 can say what the visit was.

player_4, your follow and player_3's empty-door watch can't both be right, and you've had to reword the result twice. Player_3, what exact words did your watch return? Before anyone votes, I'd like each of you to say which role your result came from and whether anyone else can confirm the night.

I'm the Healer; night 1 I protected player_10 and no save was announced. player_5, your check on player_8 is the only hard claim so far, so I'd like to hear player_8's sigil claim tested against it. Vote-wise I'd lean player_3 or player_4 until the Sentinel/Trailseer clash resolves.

player_4, I'm not going to play your follow game: nobody targeted you last night, so the visit you describe can't be real. Either your result is invented or you're misreading it, and that's the thing to press. player_8's sigil claim fits the record, so I'd rather test player_4's story than vote on wording.

I'm the Healer; night 1 I protected player_10 and no attack on them was announced. player_5, a Sentinel's own watch never appears in its result, so player_3's empty door doesn't disprove the Sentinel claim. player_3, you said you visited no one, but a watch on player_4 is a visit, so reconcile that. I'd vote player_3 today.
(passed)

player_4, I'm player_3 and I did not visit anyone on night 1, so the visit you describe is not real. Nothing targeted you that night, and I did not go near your door. Your follow result can't be right, so drop the story or name who you think came to you.

player_5's point doesn't hold: a Sentinel's watch never shows the watcher, so player_3 visiting player_4's door would not contradict an empty watch. The real conflict is player_4's follow against player_3's watch, and one of them is lying. I'd vote player_4 today, since the visit claim is the one that adds a false trace.
(passed)
